practiceSets.title: Describing Yourself and Your Family
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about who you are and the people in your family.

mcqQuestions.stemText: My mother and father are my ___.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe your family members. Please talk about who they are and what they look like. You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about yourself. What is your name, how old are you, and what things do you like to do? You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Your Home and Bedroom
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about the rooms in your house and the things in your bedroom.

mcqQuestions.stemText: There is a big ___ on the floor.
I put my clothes in the ___.
I wash my hands in the ___.
The cat is sleeping ___ the bed.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe your house or apartment. What rooms does it have and what does it look like from the outside? You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about your bedroom. What furniture is in it, and why do you like spending time there? You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Food You Like and Dislike
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about your favorite foods and the meals you eat every day.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I do not like to eat ___.
I use a knife to cut ___.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe a meal you eat every day. What foods do you usually have on your plate? You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about a food you really like and a food you do not like. Why do you feel this way? You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Your Daily Routine
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about the things you do every morning, afternoon, and night.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I brush my ___ in the morning.
I have ___ at 8 o'clock in the morning.
In the afternoon, I do my ___.
I eat ___ with my family at 7 PM.
I read a book before I go to ___.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe what you do in the morning before you leave your house. Talk about the things you do step by step. You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about your evening routine. What do you do after dinner before you go to sleep? You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Weather and Seasons
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about sunny days, rain, and the different times of the year.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I wear a thick coat in the ___.
It is ___ today. Take an umbrella.
I like to play in the ___.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe the weather today in your city. Is it hot, cold, or raining right now? You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about your favorite season. What is the weather like, and what do you like to do in that season? You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Animals and Pets
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about common animals, pets, and the things they do.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I give food to my cat every ___.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe an animal you think is very interesting. What does it look like and what does it eat? You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about a pet you have or a pet you want to have in the future. Why do you like this animal? You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Numbers and Telling Time
practiceSets.description: Practice saying numbers, dates, and times of the day clearly.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I have ___ fingers on my hands.
I go home at half ___ four.
There are seven days in a ___.
My birthday is on the ___ of May.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe a busy day in your life. What time do you do different things during the day? You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about important numbers in your life, like your age, your phone number, or the date of your birthday. You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Colors and Clothes
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about what you wear and the colors of different clothes.

mcqQuestions.stemText: The color of the sun is ___.
She wears a beautiful ___ to the party.
I put a ___ on my head.
When it is cold, I wear a ___.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe the clothes you are wearing right now. What colors are they, and are they comfortable? You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about your favorite clothes. Where do you go when you wear them, and why do you like them? You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Your School or Workplace
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about the place where you go to study or work.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I sit on a ___ in the classroom.
I have a pen in my ___.
I play with my friends at ___.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe your classroom or your office. What do you see there, and where do you usually sit? You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about a person you talk to at school or work every day. What do you talk about? You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Things You Do on Weekends
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about your free time and the fun things you do on Saturday and Sunday.

mcqQuestions.stemText: On Saturday, I like to ___ in the park.
I go to the cinema to watch a ___.
We eat a big breakfast on Sunday ___.
I ___ my friends on the weekend.
Sometimes, I ___ games on my computer.
The weekend is a good time to ___.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe what you usually do on a Saturday morning. Do you wake up early or sleep late? You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about a really fun weekend you remember. What did you do and who were you with? You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Greetings and Introductions
practiceSets.description: Practice saying hello, goodbye, and telling people who you are.

mcqQuestions.stemText: When I see my friend, I say ***.
I introduce my ___ to my parents.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe how you say hello to your friends. What words do you use, and do you smile or wave? You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about a time you met someone new. How did you introduce yourself to them? You have 45 seconds to speak.

practiceSets.title: Places in Your Town
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about stores, parks, and other buildings in your city.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I see a doctor at the ___.
We wait for the bus at the bus ___.
There are many ___ in my city.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe a place in your town where you like to go. What is there and what can you do? You have 45 seconds to speak.
Tell me about a place in your town you visit with your family or friends. Why do you go there together? You have 45 seconds to speak.
